messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1948123456 — service: inference-api-us-west-2 | symptom: elevated 5xx rate and increased tail latency. Pager routed to oncall @alex. Automatic fallback to smaller model FAILED to engage. Please acknowledge and follow runbook steps.

alex: acked. seeing ~3.4% 5xx, spike started ~02:13 UTC. I’m toggling traffic to standby pool and enabling manual fallback now. Will post logs. :eyes:

alex: mitigation in progress — traffic shifted to standby nodes (manual routing). errors dropping to 0.9% within a minute. continuing to monitor.

deploy-bot: deploy event detected: rollout 2026-03-15T02:10Z -> model-serving/variant-stable v2.3.4 -> 5 instances. No automated rollback.

jon: hey — I think the autoscaler didn't apply the fallback flag because the variant label changed in the last rollout. saw this in the controller logs: ```ERROR controller.go: failed to match fallback profile: label mismatch: expected=stable, got=stable-v2```

maria: good catch — that label mismatch explains automated fallback missing. alex — can you keep traffic on standby until we confirm root cause and patch controller?

alex: yes holding on standby. latency looks normal. current 95p latency ~120ms, requests per sec ~420.

kevin: support received 6 customer tickets flagged as degraded experience (mostly higher latency). none reported timeouts but two reported increased error messages in logs. I flagged enterprise customers A&N, reached out via account reps.

tara: thanks — want a quick customer impact summary for postmortem: which tenants hit the error pattern vs latency-only? kevin: can you post the two tenant ids and a short timeline?

kevin: tenant-A: errors peaked 02:14-02:18 UTC, ~12 failed requests per minute. tenant-N: latency only, elevated from 02:12-02:30. I’ll add notes in the incident doc.

maria: next steps: 1) schedule postmortem meeting and owner 2) update on-call runbook fallback section to include label-tolerant matching 3) add test in rollout CI to ensure label conventions are enforced 4) follow-up action owners + ETA. Assigning provisional owners below.

alex: I can draft the incident timeline and attach logs. jon you take the controller patch (label matching tolerant) and test. marIa — can you handle runbook edits? (cc @ops-runbook-bot)

jon: taking controller patch. I’ll open a PR and include a unit test for label parsing edge cases. target PR today EOD.

ops-runbook-bot: runbook check — current doc: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/oncall-fallback.md (v3.1). Last edit 2026-02-02 by maria. Suggested update candidates: tolerant label matching, explicit manual routing steps, and clear handoff checklist.

maria: draft plan for runbook patch (copying here): ```- Fallback: change match rule to allow prefix matches for variant labels (e.g., "stable" matches "stable", "stable-v2"). - Add pre-deploy CI check: `scripts/validate_variant_labels.sh` fails on non-conforming labels. - Handoff checklist: 1) confirm fallback engaged 2) confirm traffic rerouted 3) confirm customer triage started 4) create postmortem doc link.```

alex: that checklist would have helped. also add a quick troubleshooting snippet for oncall to run: ```# check fallback status curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/fallback/status | jq . -r```

jon: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-controller/pull/812 — implements prefix-tolerant matching, adds unit tests. leaving WIP until CI passes.

maria: created postmortem doc skeleton: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xpm-incident-1948123456 (please add notes). Proposed postmortem meeting: 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC (60m). Who can attend?

tara: I’ll be there for customer impact walk-through. kevin will present customer timeline. ops can cover runbook changes.

kevin: I can present customer summary and tickets. I’ll collect message snippets from account reps and attach to doc.

maria: action item list (owner / ETA): - controller: prefix-label patch (jon / 2026-03-15 EOD) - runbook: update fallback & checklist (maria / 2026-03-17) - CI: add label validator (eng-platform / 2026-03-20) - alerting: add a golden signal to detect fallback non-engagement (alex / 2026-03-18) - customer comms: account outreach summary (kevin / 2026-03-16)

alex: I’ll also add a quick oncall note: when you see a deploy that changes variant labels, manually verify fallback match before relying on automation. I'll add a short snippet to runbook.

ops-runbook-bot: created PR for runbook: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/221 - includes checklist and troubleshooting snippet. Waiting for review.

maria: scheduling: I’ll own the postmortem meeting invite; will set agenda to include timeline, root cause, action items review, and runbook changes. Please add any pre-reads to the doc.

alex: handing off live monitoring to jon for the remainder of the shift — jon you own until 08:00 UTC. I’ll be offline at 03:30 UTC.

jon: taking handoff. ping me if something pops. I’ve got dashboard watch open and alerts muted to critical-only.

tara: quick note on SLAs — we should check whether elevated latency violated any contractual SLOs for tenant-A; kevin please include that in your comms.

kevin: will check and report in postmortem doc.

maria: final: please ack action items in the doc and add owners if different. Thanks everyone — good catch on the label mismatch, solid mitigation by alex. closing incident thread once postmortem scheduled and PRs created. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks, team.

ops-runbook-bot: incident thread archived to incidents/1948123456. Postmortem draft link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xpm-incident-1948123456 - add notes there.
